prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: I need someone to help me make a "Workable" SaaS replica
I want to make a SaaS like "Workable" I need a team of Devs or a Full Stack dev to help me plan the requirements and begin making the SaaS. Budget is not final and no time wasters please. https://www.workable.com/
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):

client: Juniper & Ash Home

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

Your Workable-style SaaS idea is the kind of product I’d approach carefully from the start: clarify the core workflows, define the MVP requirements, and then build a clean foundation that can support growth. For a platform like this, I’d focus on the essentials first—user roles, job and candidate management, workflow stages, searchable data structures, and a reliable admin experience—so the product is practical before it becomes complex.

I’ve helped build products with a similar need for speed, structure, and usability. For Juniper & Ash Home, I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS that the marketing team could edit themselves. That project used Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, Sanity, and Vercel, and it improved the largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s while increasing organic traffic by 38% in 3 months. That experience reinforced how important it is to balance product flexibility with strong performance and a maintainable architecture.

If we work together, I can help you plan the requirements, break the product into buildable phases, and start implementing the first version with the right technical decisions upfront. I’m comfortable working as part of a team or taking ownership of the full stack side of the project, including frontend UI, backend logic, database design, and API integration.

I’m not interested in wasting your time or mine. If you want a serious partner to help shape and build a Workable-like SaaS the right way, I’d be glad to discuss the scope and next steps.
